title: chiazospermum erectum
intro: Chiazospermum erectum, commonly known as Bupleurum, is a flowering plant in the family Apiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve liver function, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The bioactive constituents of Bupleurum include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
